about: Citywide and borough-wide contests on New York City municipal general-election ballots, 1897-1997, compiled from English Wikipedia election articles (wikitext fetched 2026-10-20). Only data stated on the cited page is included; missing values are null. 'p' lists ballot lines as named on the page; 'pv' gives per-line votes when the page gives them; 'v' is the candidate's total as given on the page (or the sum of per-line votes when no total row is given). 'complete': false marks contests whose candidate list on the page is partial. 'dateSource': 'page' means the date is stated on the page; 'rule' means the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November. Boro codes: 1 Manhattan, 2 Bronx, 3 Brooklyn, 4 Queens, 5 Staten Island/Richmond. Wikipedia has no article (or no results) for many citywide and borough races in this period, so most years list only some of the offices that were on the ballot.
